scope: First bounded common operation: impact of version replacement on recorded dependencies. Role/exception execution, temporal policy evaluation and live enforcement deferred; no general rule language implemented.

input.snapshot: nodes and edges, at most 100 nodes/200 edges; UTF-8 serialized payload <=128KiB
input.node: unique nonempty id, kind, immutable nonempty version string; exact Unicode codepoint equality, no trimming/coercion; duplicate ids rejected even if equal
input.edge: dependent and prerequisite ids, both resolve to unique nodes in snapshot; same pair duplicates collapse; versions inherited from immutable endpoint nodes
input.coverage: status complete or partial; complete must explicitly cover all dependency edges needed for every listed candidate in this snapshot; cannot infer complete from absent edges
input.candidates: unique subset of node IDs to classify, maximum100
input.event: one replacement {event_id, sequence, node_id, old_version, new_version}; old/new nonempty unequal strings, sequence positive integer (bool rejected); ledger next_sequence and accepted-event hashes supplied

operation.edge_direction: dependent -> prerequisite. Reverse reachability from changed node finds dependent candidates. Changed node itself included when a candidate.
operation.closure: Visited-set finite traversal, including cycles. No depth truncation; input above bound is unknown, never partial allow. Return deterministic sorted results and at least one stable shortest witness path for every stale candidate, tie break lexicographic IDs.
operation.classification: stale if an explicit path reaches changed old-version node; unaffected only if no path AND coverage complete; otherwise unknown. Stale means prior binding requires recheck, not false source fact or approval denial.
operation.precedence: Invalid schema, unknown event target or version conflict -> all candidates unknown. For valid snapshot/event, known path gives stale even under partial coverage; non-reachable candidates unknown under partial coverage. This impact classification is NOT the earlier approval probe allow/deny/unknown contract.
operation.comparison: All arms receive identical snapshot, event, coverage and candidates. A indexed Python, B generic declarative JSON, C RDF traversal plus SHACL preflight; record actual checker invocation separately. No SHACL superiority attribution from shared input guard or traversal.

event_ordering.first: Require sequence==next_sequence and old_version==snapshot node version before evaluation. State change only in a new output snapshot; retain original.
event_ordering.duplicate: Exact previously accepted event_id plus same canonical payload hash returns saved result with replay=true and no second update. Same id/different payload -> unknown conflict.
event_ordering.out_of_order: Sequence below/above next_sequence with unseen id -> unknown order conflict; no automatic replay/reorder or last-writer-wins.
event_ordering.canonical_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=False, no newline, no floats permitted in event. Persist algorithm identifier. Existing research_ops packet hash uses its historical encoding and must not be recomputed with this new encoding.

output.candidate_result: {id, impact: stale|unaffected|unknown, reasons:[code], witness_path:[ids]}; path empty except stale; all supplied candidates appear, even failure
output.provenance: Source projection keeps source file hashes and explicit JSON pointers; hash integrity does not authenticate reviewer identity or establish evidence completeness.
output.no_allow: No output grants execution or modifies any live review; host atomic version check is outside this shadow contract.
